note: Block Type Templates is a pure theming helper (no config, permissions, services or plugins). hook_theme_suggestions_block_alter adds block__block_content_<block_type> and block__block_content_<block_type>__<view_mode> suggestions (files block--block-content-<block-type>.html.twig etc.) for blocks whose content is a BlockContentInterface. template_preprocess_block adds CSS classes block-content + block-type--<bundle> (block_content) and inline-block + block-type--<derivative> (inline_block/Layout Builder). Its behaviour keys off the existence of a block content type (bundle); medium/hard cases create real block content types and the hard verify actually invokes the module's suggestion hook to confirm the per-type/view-mode suggestion is emitted.

evals.prompt: With the Block Type Templates module enabled, what Twig template file name can I create to theme all content blocks of a block type whose machine name is 'testimonial', and how do I also target the 'teaser' view mode?
evals.expected_output: Create block--block-content-testimonial.html.twig (suggestion block__block_content_testimonial); for a view mode add block--block-content-testimonial--teaser.html.twig (block__block_content_testimonial__teaser). Underscores in the machine name become hyphens in the filename.

evals.prompt: Besides template suggestions, what CSS classes does the Block Type Templates module add to a rendered content block (and to a Layout Builder inline block) so I can style blocks per type?
evals.expected_output: For content blocks it adds block-content and block-type--<bundle>; for Layout Builder inline blocks it adds inline-block and block-type--<derivative> (bundle run through Html::cleanCssIdentifier).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site a custom block (content) type has been added. Inspect the site, give its machine name, and state the Twig template file name Block Type Templates makes available for it.
evals.expected_output: The block content type machine name is btt_known (drush eval or /admin/structure/block-content/types); Block Type Templates enables block--block-content-btt-known.html.twig (suggestion block__block_content_btt_known).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a custom block content type used for view-mode-specific theming. Inspect the site to find its machine name, then give the Twig template file name Block Type Templates makes available for rendering that block type in the 'teaser' view mode.
evals.expected_output: The block content type is btt_vm; for the teaser view mode the file is block--block-content-btt-vm--teaser.html.twig (suggestion block__block_content_btt_vm__teaser).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a block content type with machine name 'btt_task' so that the Block Type Templates module provides a dedicated Twig template suggestion for blocks of that type. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a block content type btt_task (BlockContentType::create(['id'=>'btt_task','label'=>...])->save(), or /admin/structure/block-content/types/add). Block Type Templates then emits the suggestion block__block_content_btt_task for blocks of that type.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a block content type with machine name 'btt_hero' so that Block Type Templates offers both a per-type template and a per-view-mode template (for the 'full' view mode) for blocks of that type. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a block content type btt_hero. Block Type Templates then emits both block__block_content_btt_hero and (for the full view mode) block__block_content_btt_hero__full, so templates block--block-content-btt-hero.html.twig and block--block-content-btt-hero--full.html.twig apply.
